description: This file defines the OpenIdValidationService class, which implements validation and management of OpenID Connect validation settings within the OrchardCore framework. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and validating OpenID validation configurations, with specific focus on tenant validation and scope management.

classes.name: OpenIdValidationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing, retrieving, updating, and validating OpenID Connect validation settings within OrchardCore, including tenant validation and scope management.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current OpenIdValidationSettings from site settings.

methods.name: LoadSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the OpenIdValidationSettings from site settings.

methods.name: GetSettingsFromContainer
methods.description: Extracts OpenIdValidationSettings from a given site container, defaulting if not present.

methods.name: UpdateSettingsAsync
methods.description: Updates the site settings with new OpenIdValidationSettings.

methods.name: ValidateSettingsAsync
methods.description: Validates the provided OpenIdValidationSettings, checking URI formats, tenant validity, and scope existence.
